sql: with r as (select distinct on (g.id) e.key exp, g.gate_key, r.verdict, r.computed_at, r.computed_by, r.explanation from experiment_gate_results r join experiment_gates g on g.id=r.gate_id join experiment_versions v on v.id=g.version_id join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id where e.key in ('mmsell-type-tight','mmsell-variants-2026-07') order by g.id, r.computed_at desc) select exp, verdict, to_char(computed_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') at, computed_by, i, substr(explanation, i*90+1, 90) txt from r cross join generate_series(0,40) i where length(explanation) > i*90 order by exp, i
